sources.name: City of Dacono: Main City Calendar
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. CivicPlus; cityofdacono.com now redirects here. The main calendar (CID 14): 122 items from 7 October 2026 to December 2030, nearly all meetings (Planning and Zoning 83 under two spellings, City Council 28, with "- canceled" appended to a called-off one rather than STATUS:CANCELLED, as Longmont does) at City Hall, 512 Cherry Avenue, Building C. The rest: the Veterans Wall of Honor Ceremony (8 November, no venue in the feed), the Carbon Valley Holiday Festival (5 December; the City's page says 4 to 6 pm at City Hall), Election Day and the office closures. The City's community events (Boot Scoot'n Bash in June at Centennial Field, the Fall Fiesta in early October at Clem DuFour Park, National Night Out on the first Tuesday in August, the Citywide Garage Sale in June, the Music & Spirits Festival, whose own calendar CID 32 is empty and whose 2027 date is not yet published) live on pages under /1012/Events-Fun, not on the calendar, so that hub is read by hand (daconoco-gov-events). The server reset the connection three times in forty fetches; each retry answered. robots.txt disallows /rss.aspx, which this does not read. America/Denver times. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's. Exclusions set 5 October 2026 from the event standard in docs/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (routine meetings, the court and office closures are not events), at the owner's direction that the sources be settled on the editor's judgment; remove any to have it staged again. What remains after the exclusions on 5 October: the Veterans Wall of Honor Ceremony and the Carbon Valley Holiday Festival.

sources.name: Town of Firestone: Town calendar
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. CivicPlus. The Town's main calendar (CID 33, "Town of Firestone"): 45 items from 7 October 2026 to August 2027, a superset of the Special Events calendar below. Most are meetings and the court (Planning & Zoning 20, Municipal Court 6, Board of Trustees 5) and office closures; the rest are the Town's own events: National Coffee with a Cop Day (7 October), Chat with a Trustee (7 October, 4 November, at the Police Department, 9900 Park Avenue), Free Tree Limb Drop-Off (10 October, 7500 County Road 20), Drug Take Back Day, and the three special events. Meetings carry no LOCATION; a few locations hold pasted HTML, which ingest's venue guess will flag. Under the event standard the regular meetings and the court are not events; the editor may exclude their titles as Longmont's registry does. The 2026 special-events lineup (/132/Programs-Events) lists fourteen dates, most of them past: 4th at Firestone (parade down First Street, 4 July), Picnic in the Park (21 August, Peninsula Park), Carbon Valley Kids Day (6 June, Stoneridge Park), the Art & Music Show (17 September to 22 October at the library), Arbor Day, Clean Up Day, the monthly tree-limb drop-offs. robots.txt disallows /RSS.aspx and /CurrentEvents*.aspx, neither of which this reads. America/Denver times. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's. Exclusions set 5 October 2026 from the event standard in docs/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (routine meetings, the court and office closures are not events), at the owner's direction that the sources be settled on the editor's judgment; remove any to have it staged again. Confirmed instead of the Special Events calendar because it carries the same three events plus the Town's smaller ones (Coffee with a Cop, Chat with a Trustee, the tree-limb drop-off, Drug Take Back Day). "Tree Limb" excluded on 5 October 2026 at the review: the drop-off days are a Town service for residents, not an event.

sources.name: Town of Frederick: Frederick Events Calendar

America/Denver times. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's.

sources.name: Town of Frederick: Frederick Meetings Calendar
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. The Town's second public calendar (CID 38): 77 items to December 2030 on 5 October, every one a board or commission meeting (Board of Trustees regular and work sessions, Planning Commission, Parks, Recreation, Open Space & Trails Commission, Historic Preservation Committee, Frederick Arts Committee, Youth Commission, Urban Renewal Authority), with no LOCATION. The two titles excluded are the calendar's own placeholders ("One Time Event" on 31 December 2030, "Parking Lot for Agenda Items" on 30 December 2027), not meetings. Under the event standard (docs/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md) routine meetings are not events; whether to confirm this feed at all, or exclude the regular sessions as Longmont's registry does, is the editor's call. The Town's nine other iCal categories (Centennial Park, Crist Park, Frederick Recreation Area, Downtown Activities, each board on its own) were each read once and are empty. Left proposed 5 October 2026: every item is a routine meeting, which the event standard excludes; confirm it only to have the meetings staged.

sources.name: Weld County: events listing
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. Granicus OpenCities (weldgov.com redirects here). The county's events listing filters by location, with Dacono, Firestone and Frederick each a choice, but only through an ASP.NET form post, and neither it, the County Calendar nor an event's own page offers iCal, RSS or JSON. Core as Boulder County is for Niwot and Lyons, but read by a person who sets the location filter; the county's offices and fairgrounds are in Greeley, thirty miles off. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's.

sources.name: Carbon Valley Regional Library (High Plains Library District), LibCal
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. One branch serves all three towns: 7 Park Avenue, Firestone (Mon to Thu 9 am to 8 pm, Fri and Sat 10 am to 5 pm, Sun 1 to 5 pm, per mylibrary.us/locations-and-hours/). The district's LibCal is the same one the Windsor and Johnstown work found: its public iCal (ical_subscribe.php?src=p&cid=8181) is the district's 500 oldest items, 4 August to 25 September 2026 on 5 October, and no parameter (cal, cm, inc, d, t) narrows it to the branch or moves it forward, re-tested three ways. The district-wide RSS (rss.php?iid=4057&m=month&cid=8181; m=upcoming answers "invalid mode") does carry the coming fortnight, 300 items on 5 October of which 19 were at the Carbon Valley Regional Library (Drop-in Chess, English Class, Tween Craft Club, Sketch Club, Page Turner's Book Club), but its dates, times and building are inside each item's description, which the repo's RSS reader does not read (it reads CivicPlus's calendarEvent elements), so ingest would stage nothing from it: reading LibCal RSS would be a new feed reader, which is a feature to ask about. Until then the branch's calendar page, linked above with the building preselected, is read in a browser. robots.txt names a 10-second crawl delay for everyone and disallows the /process_ endpoints the page loads events from, so the page cannot be read by script either. The locationFilter is set for the day a reader exists. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's. Read as RSS from 5 October 2026: scripts/lib/feeds/rss.ts now reads LibCal's own libcal:date, libcal:time, libcal:location and libcal:campus elements (the district-wide feed covers the coming fortnight or so, 300 items on 5 October), and the locationFilter keeps the branch's. Exclusions set 5 October 2026 from the event standard in docs/AUDIT-2026-10-02.md (routine meetings, the court and office closures are not events), at the owner's direction that the sources be settled on the editor's judgment; remove any to have it staged again. Storytimes, clubs, drop-ins, the English class and the advisory board are excluded; what remains is the one-off programs (a science afternoon, a teen improv session, an adult D&D one-shot, a 3D-modelling class). The feed marks a called-off session by prefixing "Cancelled:" to the title, as Longmont's does. The branch is in Firestone, so staged items carry subTown firestone. Excluded on 5 October 2026 at the review: "Let’s Draw!" and "Science Fun", monthly after-school sessions for elementary pupils (a class in all but name, under the event standard). "Ageless Grace" was already excluded; its cancelled session reached staging because the feed wrote a non-breaking space in the title, which the readers now treat as a space. Feed narrowed on 5 October 2026 to the branch with cam=4554 (the calendar's own building filter): 62 items, all at Carbon Valley, reaching about a month ahead where the district feed's 300 reach a fortnight. The locationFilter stays as a guard. Further exclusions on 5 October 2026, with the branch feed: the baby storytime (Twinkle Babies), the job-help drop-in, the legal clinic, Library 101, the monthly Paws to Read, make-and-take craft classes (Cricut, tote bags, looming), as Longmont excludes them, and the bird walk at Golden Ponds, which is in Longmont.

sources.name: Carbon Valley Parks and Recreation District
sources.notes: Found and read once on 5 October 2026. The special district (established 1983, 45 square miles: Dacono, Firestone, Frederick and the country between) that runs the Carbon Valley Recreation Center, 701 Fifth Street, Frederick, the Community (Active Adults) Center and the Gymnastics Center, and the recreation programming for all three towns. Streamline (CivicPlus) site with no events module, no calendar page and no feed; the Special Events page is a hand-written list ("2026 Schedule of Events": Carbon Valley Kids Day 6 June in Firestone, Boot Scoot'n Bash 12 June in Dacono, the Chamber Open 17 August, Miners Day 19 September in Frederick, Zumba Glow Party 16 October, Eye of Freedom Encounter 28 October, Harvest & Holly Market 15 November 11 am to 3 pm at the Recreation Center, Burn the Bird Fitness Party 27 November) and the Active Adults page another (Senior Resource Fair, Empty Bowls Painting Party 12 October). Programs register through CivicRec (secure.rec1.com), which has no feed. The monthly Rec Connect newsletter PDF (/rec-connect-newsletter) is the fullest schedule. robots.txt allows everything but the SEO bots. Read by hand; each event's subTown is where it is held, not the district. Confirmed 5 October 2026 on the owner's word that the choice was the editor's.
